about: Monday Oct 12 2026: every US-traded $2B+ stock that moved 10%+ on real volume (TradingView screener), with the first headlines News247 can read at their TradingView timestamps (unix seconds, UTC). 'lag' is how long after publication News247 reads that source: Benzinga through the Alpaca news stream 60 s; Google News queries (gnews-gse-investors) are polled every 90 s but index a story minutes to half an hour after it runs, so they are given 30 min. Headlines from sources News247 does not read (Zacks, GuruFocus, Binance News) are left out; the Stocktwits and Seeking Alpha stories reach it only through Google News. Move times: the 5-minute bar in which the radar's push line was crossed (mid caps $2-10B push at 15%, large caps $10-200B at 9%), from TradingView 5m bars; FIGS (+13.9% at its high) never reached its 15% line, so its radar alert is MEDIUM and the scorecard leaves it out. Before the Oct 13 fixes FNMA and FMCC were not in the universe (they trade over the counter, which Nasdaq's screener leaves out) and every Fannie/Freddie headline tagged FICO, RKT and UWMC instead, so the radar never saw the moves and no headline named them. CBRS and SMTC fell with semiconductors (SOXX -2.6%, 'China chip concerns' after CXMT's server-memory push): sector beta, no company catalyst.
